item.title: How to Extract Table Data from PDFs Using 3 Python Libraries (tabula-py, pdfplumber, PyPDF2)
item.description: Extracting table data from PDFs can be a daunting task, but Python provides several powerful libraries to help you get the job done efficiently. In this article, we’ll explore seven different Python libraries and demonstrate how to extract table data from a sample PDF document.
